title.en: Write it, then read it back

hints.tr: Yazmak için kip `"w"`: `with open("names.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:`
hints.en: The mode for writing is `"w"`: `with open("names.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:`

hints.tr: Her satırın sonuna `\n` koy, yoksa üç isim tek satıra biner: `file.write("Ada\n")`
hints.en: Put `\n` at the end of each line, or the three names end up on one line: `file.write("Ada\n")`

hints.tr: Okurken kip yazmana gerek yok, varsayılan zaten okuma. `file.read().splitlines()` satır sonlarını temizleyerek liste veriyor.
hints.en: You do not need a mode when reading; the default is already read. `file.read().splitlines()` gives you a list with the line endings stripped.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
with open("names.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("Ada\n")
    file.write("Alan\n")
    file.write("Grace\n")


with open("names.txt", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    names = file.read().splitlines()


print(len(names))
print(names)
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
with open("names.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    file.write("Ada\n")
    file.write("Alan\n")
    file.write("Grace\n")


with open("names.txt", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    names = file.read().splitlines()


print(len(names))
print(names)
```

hint.tr: Dosyayı `with` ile açman gerekiyor. Elle `open` ve `close` yazmak, araya hata girdiğinde dosyayı açık bırakıyor.
hint.en: You need to open the file with `with`. Writing `open` and `close` by hand leaves the file open if an error gets in the way.
